cases.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
  (for/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range (rows g))))
    (let ((anchors (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 9)) (range (cols g)))))
      (if (empty? anchors) out
          (let* ((a (first anchors))
                 (sources (filter (lambda (c) (not (member? (at g r c) (list 0 9))))
                                  (range (cols g))))
                 (cue (argmin (lambda (c) (abs (- c a))) sources))
                 (selected-color (at g r cue)))
            (for/fold ((acc out)) ((c (in-list sources)))
              (let ((v (at g r c)) (mc (- (* 2 a) c)))
                (if (and (= v selected-color) (in-bounds? r mc (rows g) (cols g)))
                    (set-cell acc r mc v) acc)))))))))

(lambda (g) (for/fold ((out g)) ((r (in-range (rows g)))) (let* ((anchors (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) 9)) (range (cols g)))) (sources (filter (lambda (c) (and (>= (at g r c) 1) (<= (at g r c) 8))) (range (cols g))))) (if (or (empty? anchors) (empty? sources)) out (let* ((axis (first anchors)) (members (lambda (color) (filter (lambda (c) (= (at g r c) color)) sources))) (distances (lambda (color) (map (lambda (c) (abs (- c axis))) (members color)))) (colors (filter (lambda (color) (not (empty? (members color)))) (range 1 9))) (selected (for/fold ((best (first colors))) ((color (in-list colors))) (if (< (* (apply + (distances color)) (length (members best))) (* (apply + (distances best)) (length (members color)))) color best)))) (for/fold ((acc out)) ((c (in-list sources))) (if (= (at g r c) selected) (set-cell acc r (- (* 2 axis) c) selected) acc))))))))
